stops.name: Parque Natural y Reserva de la Biosfera de El Montseny
stops.detail: The Natural Park and Reserve of the biosphere of El Montseny () () is a Spanish protected space in the province of Barcelona, Catalonia. It forms part of the 14 natural spaces that manage the Diputación de Barcelona and protect an area of the Catalan pretierra range, from which the Montseny massizo is the highest. It includes territories of the districts of Osona, Vallés Oriental and La Selva. Highlights are his pronounced reliefs and his rich ecological diversity. That's why Unesco declared him a biosphere reserve in 1978. It currently operates by the Diputación de Barcelona and the Diputación de Gerona.)
